test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Daniel is buying a car.

options.text: A car is bought by Daniel.
A car is buy by Daniel.
A car is being bought by Daniel.
A car were being bought by Daniel

solution:
The correct answer is: "**A car is being bought by Daniel.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in active voice, with the subject "**Daniel**" performing the action of buying a car.
 
• The object of the active sentence "**a car**" becomes the new subject in the passive voice sentence.
 
• To convert it to passive voice, we use a form of the verb "**be**", in this case, "**is being**" followed by the past participle of the main verb, which is "**bought**."
 
• The sentence now reads "*A car is being bought by Daniel*" with the emphasis on the car rather than the person buying it.
 
• In the passive voice sentence, the focus shifts from Daniel, the doer of the action, to the car, which is now the receiver of the action.

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.
